text:
maya: quick sync — we need to lock down acceptance criteria for tenant-level keystore (BYOK) handshake for next sprint. customer pilot starts in 3 weeks.
liam: list what we absolutely need vs nice-to-have?
maya: absolutely: API for onboarding keys, proof-of-possession handshake, key usage audit events, key rotation support, clear rollback/fallback to platform-managed key. nice-to-have: UI in console, tenant-scoped key listing, cross-tenant export.
samir: ops constraints: we need SLA on KMS availability for dedicated/private. propose 99.9% for handshake operations, and 4s P99 for successful handshake under normal load. also need fallback path if external KMS unreachable.
aj: from SDK/docs side — handshake flow should be a single API call + webhook callback for async KMS confirmation. minimal request example: ```POST /v1/tenants/:tid/keys/handshake {"kek_uri":"kms://gcp/project/keyRing/key","publicKey":"<pem>"}``` response should include a handshake_id and status.
rachel (legal): for SOC2 evidence we need immutable audit logs for key onboarding/usage with timestamped events for: create, rotate, revoke, operator-access. retention: 7 years for some customers, but default 2 years. need ability to export audit bundle on-demand.
liam: can we map that to events we already capture for audit-logs? which event fields do we need?
maya: event fields: tenant_id, key_id (opaque), operation, caller_id, request_id, timestamp, result (success/fail), kms_provider, metadata (optional). include raw request blob for onboarding ops.
samir: storage implications: keeping full raw blobs for 7 years is heavy. propose we store structured events for 7y and raw blobs 90 days, with option for customer to request extended raw export into their bucket.
aj: devex: need sample webhook consumer + retry semantics doc. Also add SDK helper to sign PoP (proof of possession) if provider requires it.
rachel (legal): also need legal-hold flag to prevent deletion/archival on a per-tenant request. must tie to access logs so we can produce chain-of-custody.
liam: technical handshake sequence suggestion: 1) tenant POSTs key URI + meta 2) our platform validates URI 3) platform issues challenge nonce 4) tenant/KMS signs nonce and returns signature 5) platform verifies and marks key active.
maya: exactly. acceptance tests: happy path handshake end-to-end, replay/nonce-reuse rejection, invalid-signature rejection, provider-unreachable fallback, audit event emitted for each step.
samir: operational runbooks: how to escalate when KMS times out, circuit breaker thresholds, automated fallback to platform-managed key with opt-in by tenant, and customer notification template.
aj: can we do a canary rollout? expose handshake toggle per-tenant so we can flip for pilot customers.
maya: yes — rollout gate: enabled=false by default, enable for 3 pilot tenants, run smoke tests, monitor audit event rates and p99 latency for handshake.
ops-bot: deploy queued: feature/tenant-byok-handshake -> staging at 2024-06-12T14:03Z (build 8792) :rocket:
liam: privacy note — key identifiers must be opaque and not contain customer PII. also ensure logs redact sensitive URI parts; only store provider type and truncated resource id.
rachel (legal): confirm encryption-at-rest and customer-managed encryption for audit store. also need KMS access log retention policy doc for compliance review.
maya: deliverables for next sprint: API spec (openapi), handshake acceptance tests, audit-event schema, fallback policy doc + runbook, console toggle for pilot, SDK sample.
aj: i'll own SDK sample + webhook doc.
liam: i'll own API spec + acceptance tests.
samir: i'll own runbook + fallback infra.
rachel (legal): i'll review audit schema and retention wording, will provide legal-hold template.
maya: estimate: should be doable in sprint if we scope UI to toggle only (no full listing). if blockers, pivot to API-only launch.
liam: blockers: KMS provider integrations (aws/gcp/azure). do we require full multi-cloud support day-1 for pilot?
maya: target MVP: AWS + GCP. Azure later.
samir: add a compatibility matrix doc per provider (timeouts, PoP formats).
aj: noted. I'll add SDK code samples for aws-kms and gcp-kms.
liam: can we add a short checklist for launch criteria?
maya: yes — proposed launch criteria: 1) handshake API implemented + tests, 2) audit events emitted and exportable, 3) fallback behavior verified, 4) pilot-enabled toggle in console, 5) legal-hold support documented, 6) SOC2 evidence pack generation path validated.
rachel (legal): add review sign-off from compliance and security to the checklist.
maya: ok. next sync Friday 10am to review API spec. please drop any red flags here before EOD. :thumbsup:
